Output: Project implementation support to ARS, timely and effectively provided. Indicator: A total of around 317 m of bridges reconstructed and 30 kms of local roads rehabilitated by 2017. Progress/Status: 2013-2016: Both the civil works and construction supervision consultant contracts were signed in November 2015. The construction drawings of four bridges under Tranche 4 were completed by the contractor and Ministry of Emergency approved 3 out of the 4 drawings. Shop drawings for the 3 bridges were reviewed by the Engineer and comments provided to Contractor for action. Relocation of utilities completed and demolition substantially completed. Construction activities are ongoing.
2017: All 4 bridges and all 5 local roads (41.2 km) are open to traffic. Data Source: MFF and project progress and completion reports
